messages:
irma: tiny GPU pods (0.125) piling Pending then getting evicted in eu-central1 this morning (~20 evicts).

matt: any control-plane or kubelet rollouts around that time?

irma: none. node logs show intermittent PCIe resets and nvlink flaps; heartbeat p95 jumps correlate.

sangeeta: that pattern causes scheduler to de-preference nodes -> scatters tiny-gangs -> backfill preempts the scattered pods.

devon: log excerpt:
```
I0620 09:05:12 kube-scheduler: bind failed: lease timeout
I0620 09:05:17 node: nvlink peer reset
I0620 09:05:25 eviction-controller: preempting pod small-train-21
```

opsbot: Alert: tiny-pod-evict-spike eu-central1. Incident INC-5601 created.

matt: short-term mitigation: canary a scheduler profile in a single AZ: leaseGrace=30s, nodeRecoveryCooldown=60s, taintStabilization=45s, reduce tiny backfill weight to 0.4.

sangeeta: +1. Add Grafana panels for tiny-pod eviction by AZ and nvlink/error-rate + heartbeat p50/p95 so we can rollback fast.

irma: spinning 40-node canary pool in eu-central1b and applying the profile now.

opsbot: Deploy job started: scheduler-canary -> eu-central1b (job-8122).

matt: if canary works, follow-ups are NVLINK driver/firmware investigation and scheduler smoothing for tiny-gang stickiness.

irma: canary applied, monitoring 30m. Will report back. :eyes:
